description: Dependency updates (ADR 0028 Updates; 2.1-Q17, 2.1-M57, 2.1-Q219, 2.1-Q220). Weekly, grouped minor and patch per ecosystem; each major its own PR; release sets in one PR; exact pins wait on the dashboard; security updates at once.

customManagers.description: The Playwright image tag outside workflows (configs, specs, READMEs); workflow container images come from the github-actions manager. scripts/check_playwright_pins.py keeps every copy equal to the locked @playwright/test.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch, one group per ecosystem.
Minor and patch, one group per ecosystem.
Minor and patch, one group per ecosystem.

Exact pins (npm x.y.z, Cargo =x.y.z) wait on the dependency dashboard until the user ticks them (2.1-Q220), each its own PR, since one pin in a group would hold the whole group; vulnerabilityAlerts still opens security updates at once.
Exact pins (npm x.y.z, Cargo =x.y.z) wait on the dependency dashboard until the user ticks them (2.1-Q220).
Release set: the Vitest family moves in one PR, majors included (2.1-M57).
Release set: the TypeScript pair (typescript 6 and the typescript7 compiler) moves in one PR (2.1-M57).
Release set: the Stryker packages move in one PR, since each pins the core's exact version as its peer (the mutation lane, 2.1-M60); exact pins, so the group waits on the dashboard.
Release set: specta and specta-typescript, its own PR; float emission is decided there (2.1-M212).

One cross-ecosystem Tauri group: tauri build refuses a crate and npm package of different major.minor (2.1-M57). Its exact pins (the CLI) keep the set aligned, so the group does not wait on the dashboard.
One Playwright group: the npm package and the mcr.microsoft.com/playwright image tag move together (AF23); the exact pin keeps them equal, so the group does not wait on the dashboard.
The wasm-bindgen crate and its CLI move together (ADR 0005); the CLI joins when the format worker lands.
@types/node moves only with the engines floor (toolchain-node-types.test.ts); patches within it are fine.
Node stays within engines ^24.13.0; the floor moves by hand (2.1-M220).
The Rust toolchain moves by hand with rust-toolchain.toml, before the baselines it moves (2.1-Q141).
Node stays on the engines major in workflows too (2.1-M220).

Matched by dependency name, since a git dependency's package name is its URL. Excluded: rustqual (2.1-Q142); maplibre-gl-raster, cog-tiler-wasm, deck.gl and luma.gl, and the whitebox revisions, which move only with the code that measures them.
